observations: Photo 0 shows the top of a white hair dryer with a black trim and a small orange indicator light. The brand 'EQUATOR' is visible on the top panel.
Photo 1 shows the front of the hair dryer with a transparent plastic hood and a visible fan grille inside. The hood has a black trim and a spring mechanism.
Photo 2 is a close-up of the fan grille and the curved plastic housing, showing some minor scuffs and wear on the plastic.
The hair dryer appears to be a salon-style hair dryer with a hood and a stand, as suggested by the seller's description.
No power cord, base, or control panel is visible in any photo.
The seller claims it is 'neatly used like new' and 'barely used, bought new last year'.

identity.kind: salon hair dryer with hood and stand

claims.evidence: Photos show some minor scuffs and wear on the plastic hood and housing, but no major damage is visible. The condition is not fully verifiable from the photos alone.
Brand 'EQUATOR' is clearly visible on the top panel in photo 0.
The term 'leg' likely refers to the stand or base. No stand is visible in any photo, so this claim cannot be confirmed.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The hair dryer may not be functional or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the hair dryer turning on, the fan spinning, and the hood opening/closing smoothly.

risks.risk: The stand or base may be missing or damaged, contradicting the 'with leg' claim.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full unit with the stand or base attached, or a close-up of the stand if it is separate.

risks.risk: The power cord or plug may be damaged or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the power cord and plug, showing no fraying or damage.

proof_requests: A video showing the hair dryer turning on and operating.
A photo of the stand or base if it is separate.
A photo of the power cord and plug.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
